title: Bram and the Will
author: Mara Yarrow
blurb: Tamsin Ravensworth, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
